title: Conditional κ = 0.001625744726006285: coordinated owner repair on PR614
body:
Raises the conditional rate from PR614's **κ = 0.001625715867072461** to **κ = 0.001625744726006285** by coordinated three-call and four-call owner repairs. The JP8×70/ATM3×2 dispatch, native constructions, inherited verifier code and admission rules are unchanged. This is a bounded repair of PR614; the newer PR615 claims a higher rate and is not certified by this PR.

The work applied fork-and-flush to four identical current-witness workspaces, independently graded their exact results, and continued only the strongest session. PR614 arrived during that round and was supplied after selection. The final gain uses that new public starting point plus the continuation; it is not an equal-compute experiment or proof of a distinct idea-basin escape.

Validation:
- Complete fresh macOS and Linux/Python 3.14.8 replays: **42 stages each**, no reused baseline or native artifacts.
- All **23 controller** and **114 assembly** mutants rejected, with native, phase and content-binding controls retained.
- Independent literal map/native-profile/rational-moment checker passes under `-I -O`; receipts and fourteen native artifacts match across platforms.
- Declarative inputs reconstruct SPEC; five inconsistent declarations are rejected. Bundled pinned sources make the replay portable. Python 3.11/3.14 CI is included.

Evidence: `research/complex-cold-owner-repair-validation/`. All inherited all-size, realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic-transfer and PR543 bit assumptions remain. No unconditional theorem, optimality, complete Lean proof or practical speedup is claimed.

Credits: jeremykothe2 PR614/601; DreamingOfClouds PR604; pinned PR568/569/571/575/583 and their inherited contributors. Owner repair, independent checks and packaging by chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance. All source notices and licenses are retained.
